t.zh: 二维的卷积核是一张 3 × 3 的权重表。很多常用的核正好是一列权重乘一行权重：先横着滤一遍、再竖着滤一遍，和直接用 3 × 3 的核一样。这依赖<wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>：先后次序可以交换、两次滤波可以合成一次。
t.en: A 2D kernel is a 3 × 3 table of weights. Many common kernels are exactly a column of weights times a row: filtering across and then down equals filtering once with the 3 × 3 kernel. That rests on the <wiki-ref to="linear-filter-properties"></wiki-ref>: the order can be swapped, two filters can be merged into one.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个 3 × 3 的核，什么时候能拆成横、竖两步？先由一行和一列权重写出合成的 3 × 3 核，再用行滤波器和列滤波器接出二维滤波器。
t.en: This level asks: when can a 3 × 3 kernel be split into an across pass and a down pass? First write the 3 × 3 kernel a row and a column of weights make, then wire a 2D filter from the row and column filters.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、一行权重 h1、h2、h3 和一列权重 v1、v2、v3：先横着用行权重滤，再竖着用列权重滤，图外补 0
desc.en: Takes an image, a row of weights h1, h2, h3 and a column v1, v2, v3: filters across with the row, then down with the column, 0 outside

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>：3 × 3 的核若是一列乘一行，就拆成两次 3 格的滤波，每个像素少算 3 次乘法。
after.en: This is a <wiki-ref to="separable-filter"></wiki-ref>: a 3 × 3 kernel that is a column times a row splits into two 3-cell passes, three fewer multiplications a pixel.

brief.zh: 行权重 [1, 2, 1]、列权重 [1, 2, 1]：写出合成的 3 × 3 核，第 y 行第 x 列是列权重第 y 个乘行权重第 x 个。
brief.en: Row weights [1, 2, 1], column weights [1, 2, 1]: write the merged 3 × 3 kernel, row y, column x being column weight y times row weight x.

why.zh: 这是三行都抄了行权重：竖直方向也要乘上列权重，第 1 行整行乘 2。
why.en: That copies the row weights into all three rows: the column weights multiply too, doubling row 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、行权重 h1、h2、h3 和列权重 v1、v2、v3：交出先横后竖两次滤波的结果。
brief.en: Given an image, row weights h1, h2, h3 and column weights v1, v2, v3, give the result of filtering across, then down.

hint.zh: 第二次滤波的输入，是第一次的输出。
hint.en: The second pass takes the first pass's output.
